The '''Sprizen system''' was located in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated at the endpoint of the [[Sprizen End Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]]. Almost [[1004 BBY|three millennia]] later, the majority of that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had become a part of the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point before the [[Battle of Korriban|beginning]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the Sprizen system participated in the dispute known as the [[Celanon–Sprizen Negotiation]], which was [[Diplomat/Legends|mediated]] by [[Jedi Consular]]s of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and was settled in favor of the [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] of<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|114|Celanon}}</ref> [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. However, after trade boundaries shifted due to the Great Galactic War, the dispute was reopened.<ref name="SWTORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sprizen system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
